name: GILLA
summary:
GILLA is a multiplayer VR horror game where you play as an ape. There's no walking with a stick: push off the floor and walls with your arms to run, climb and leap.

THE BASE
Explore a huge abandoned base with other players. Hunt for gold bars and diamonds, carry them back to the recycler, and smash windows and open hazard doors on the way. Monsters roam the halls and they can hear you talking, so watch what you say on voice chat. Find the keycard to get through the locked door and down into what's undernea
